title: Grand Theft Auto VI
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player game set in the state of Leonida, focused on protagonists Lucia and Jason and launching in November 2026.
bodyMarkdown:
## Overview

Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player experience.{{cite:playstation-store-ultimate}} Rockstar markets the game under the tagline Only in Leonida and highlights Vice City, USA.{{cite:gta6-official-site}}

## Release and platforms

Rockstar’s pre-load announcement shows the game as coming November 19, 2026.{{cite:gta6-pre-load-page}} The physical version contains a download code and will not include a disc.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}}

## Editions and pricing

Grand Theft Auto VI is available in Standard and Ultimate Editions.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} The Standard Edition includes the game and allows later purchase of the Ultimate Edition Upgrade.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} Take-Two lists the Standard Edition price as $79.99.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} Take-Two lists the Ultimate Edition price as $99.99.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} The Ultimate Edition is described as an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action threaded across Jason and Lucia’s story.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} Digital pre-orders and purchases prior to November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}

## Setting and protagonists

The story is set in Vice City, within the wider state of Leonida.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} Lucia Caminos was taught to fight by her father.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Lucia’s fights for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary, from which luck freed her.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Jason Duval grew up around grifters and crooks.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Jason served a stint in the Army after troubled teens.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Jason worked for local drug runners in the Keys before meeting Lucia.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

## PlayStation 5

Grand Theft Auto VI is available on PS5 and labeled PS5 Pro Enhanced.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} The PS5 version supports DualSense haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and the controller's integrated speaker.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} The game leverages the PS5 ultra-high speed SSD for near-instant load times.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} Digital pre-orders include a one-month GTA+ subscription claimable before March 31, per the PS Store listing.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} Pre-loading on PS5 began November 10 according to PlayStation's pre-load guide.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} Downloaded content can be played on the main PS5 console tied to an account and other PS5 consoles when signing in with the same account.{{cite:playstation-gta6}}

## Xbox consoles and cloud streaming

Xbox Wire says cloud-streamed sessions use Xbox Series S graphics settings.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}} Xbox Series X supports native play and pre-installation per Xbox Wire.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}} Xbox Series S is described as the most affordable way to play GTA VI natively on Xbox.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}} Streaming availability, purchasing options, supported devices, account eligibility, and features may vary by market and device.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}}

title: Story
summary: The official premise follows Jason and Lucia after an easy score goes wrong, drawing them into a statewide criminal conspiracy in Leonida where they must rely on each other.
bodyMarkdown:
## Overview

Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} An easy score goes wrong, initiating the central conflict of their story.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} They become embroiled in a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} They are forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.{{cite:gta6-official-site}}

## Protagonists

Jason wants an easy life but things keep getting harder.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Jason grew up around grifters and crooks and later worked for local drug runners in the Keys.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Fresh out of prison, Lucia is committed to a plan to change the odds in her favor.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}}

## Setting and Tone

Vice City is described as the sunniest place in America with a dark side.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} The game is set in the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}}

## Overview

The story follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos after an easy score goes wrong.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}}

## Primary protagonists

Lucia Caminos was taught to fight by her father and served time in Leonida Penitentiary.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Lucia is fresh out of prison and determined to execute a plan to change her odds.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Jason Duval grew up around grifters and crooks and served in the Army.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Jason worked for local drug runners in the Keys before recent events.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to Jason.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

## Friends and associates

Brian Heder is a classic drug runner still moving product through his boat yard.{{cite:gta6-people-cal}} Brian Heder operates with his third wife, Lori.{{cite:gta6-people-cal}}

## Vice City music scene

Boobie Ike is a Vice City entrepreneur who owns real estate, a strip club, and a recording studio.{{cite:gta6-people-cal}} Boobie partners with Dre'Quan Priest on the Only Raw Records label.{{cite:gta6-people-cal}} Dre'Quan Priest started as a hustler and aims to break into the Vice City music scene.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Dre'Quan has signed the Real Dimez to Only Raw Records.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Real Dimez are Bae-Luxe and Roxy, childhood friends turned viral rap duo.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Real Dimez rose after an early hit single with local rapper DWNPLY and are now signed to Only Raw.{{cite:gta6-people-dimez}}

Jason grew up around grifters and crooks.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} He served a stint in the Army to try to shake off his troubled teens.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

After the Army, Jason found himself in the Keys working for local drug runners.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Jason helps with local shakedowns as part of his arrangement with Brian.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

title: Boobie Ike
summary: Boobie Ike is a Vice City figure who built a legitimate empire from his street past and partners with Dre'Quan at Only Raw Records.
bodyMarkdown:
## Overview

Boobie Ike is described as a local Vice City legend who acts like it.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Boobie turned his time in the streets into a legitimate empire spanning real estate, a strip club, and a recording studio.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Boobie is noted as smiling until it is time to talk business.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}}

## Business Operations

The club money is said to pay for the recording studio.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Drug money is described as paying for all of Boobie's operations.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}}

## Only Raw Records Partnership

Boobie is most invested in his partnership with the young aspiring music mogul Dre'Quan for Only Raw Records.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Boobie and Dre'Quan are said to need a hit for Only Raw Records.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Dre'Quan is characterized as more of a hustler than a gangster with ambitions in music.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Now that Dre'Quan has signed the Real Dimez, his days of booking acts into Boobie's strip club might be numbered.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}}

title: Leonida
summary: Leonida is the fictional US state setting for Grand Theft Auto VI, centered on Vice City and surrounding locations.
bodyMarkdown:
## Overview

Leonida is the state where Grand Theft Auto VI takes place.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Rockstar describes Leonida as a sun-soaked setting where the story unfolds.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} The game’s central narrative involves a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Grand Theft Auto VI is presented as a single-player experience set in Leonida.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}}

## Notable places

Vice City is located within the state of Leonida.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}} Rockstar calls Leonida the home of Vice City and beyond.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}} The Leonida Keys are presented as a destination within the state.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Mount Kalaga is listed as an in-world location coming November 19, 2026.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Leonida Penitentiary is a location tied to Lucia Caminos’s past.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}}

## Role in the story

Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos’s story unfolds across Leonida.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} An initial easy score going wrong launches the protagonists into the state-spanning conspiracy.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Lucia was incarcerated in the Leonida Penitentiary before her release.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}}

## In-game presentation and platform notes

Rockstar markets gallery screenshots and media showcasing Leonida on the official site.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} PlayStation 5 materials state Grand Theft Auto VI is not playable on PlayStation 4.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} The Ultimate Edition features content tied to Leonida, including vehicles, apparel, and in-world items.{{cite:gta6-official-site}}
